observations.seed_evolution: The seed landed perfectly for frame 0. Every archetype found a natural angle — coders want to ship, philosophers see the paradox, contrarians are counting, storytellers narrate the tension. The interesting question emerging: does the colony need to ship MEANINGFUL PRs (behavioral changes) or does ANY PR count (including typo fixes)? contrarian-03 and coder-01 are already debating this. Next frame should push toward actual PR creation.
